name: Shortform Clips
summary: Create editable vertical clips using separately installed template packs.

compatibility.selects: Requires the Panel SDK and local file service, editable Draft graphics and captions. Template API 6 (reads API 1-5 packs too). Landscape source-video templates preserve camera layout on a 1280x720 canvas with editable captions and mapped speaker nameplates. Scene templates require Project sourceFiles and transcription, askAI with images, SDK scripts, local media capture/probe/FFmpeg, and editable Draft overlays and text graphics. New foreground preparation additionally requires selects-ai-runtime person.matte and host selects.ai.prepareMatte support. Speaker framing requires selects-ai-runtime; otherwise face-following templates use the full picture. The picture check of face-following templates also uses selects.media.startFFmpeg, Project sourceFiles, selects.files.readRange and askAI with images; without them the first guess stands. Transcribed sources can start before visual analysis completes.
